utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Dane, have you heard about the repair drive going on? I'm thinking of bringing my broken lamp.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late! A repair drive? Sounds great, I have a squeaky chair that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, bring the chair! Maybe we can get some tools together and work on our items at the same time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey, I'm looking forward to the repair drive this Saturday. I've got my tools ready and I think coordinating with the school pickup at 3 PM is a solid plan.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Mara! I'll make sure the generator behind the old library is accessible for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's really helpful, Opal! Thanks for taking care of the generator setup.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Noah, I heard about the repair drive. Need any tools or a hand with something?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I think I saw something about that... did you say it's happening today?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it's today! I've got a hammer ready for you, just say the word.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I signed up for that, but I can't remember the details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it's this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center. I'm bringing my toaster, and my neighbor Sam's bringing his blender. I'll remind you again closer to the day.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, great, thanks Vik! I'll definitely need that reminder—my memory's like a sieve these days.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Kira, I was just going over the inventory for the repair drive and we're running low on some things. Can you help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually serious about this repair drive? You know how to fix that old truck?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, the drive is more for small household items like toasters and blenders, not trucks. But if you know someone who could help with that, maybe they can join too!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira! We're having a repair drive this Saturday. Want to join us and maybe bring some tools?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, this Saturday? I thought it was supposed to be ready by today. What changed?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, no, it's this Saturday! We changed it to give everyone more time to prepare. So, can we count you in?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We should get going then. I'll grab my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, do we know for sure it's at the community center? I'd hate to carry tools there and find it's somewhere else.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's at the community center, always has been.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, I'm helping organize a repair drive and was thinking you might know some people who'd want to get involved!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, a repair drive? Could you tell me more about what exactly it involves?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's like a community fix-it event where we repair broken items together—sort of a repair café! Want to bring something or help out?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Rey! Thanks for coming to chat about the repair drive. I'm really excited to get this organized.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I'm curious too. Do you know who's heading it up?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be me! I'm the block coordinator, so I'm pulling everything together.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I'm pretty sure it's at the community center. The flyer said Saturday morning, 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'd love to help, but I'm not sure I can make it this Saturday. Things are a bit complicated right now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's too bad. Maybe another time, then? They might do more events like this.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Eli, is the repair drive finished yet?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Not yet, Mina. I'm still coordinating the tool list with Gus.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: When do you think it'll be done? I've got a few things I need to bring in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? What about it?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I heard about it and thought I could help out with fixing things. Do you know who's organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Faye mentioned it, I think she's the one behind it. You should ask her for the details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Kira, are you free this Saturday? We're doing a repair drive and could really use another pair of hands!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? You mean fixing up that old truck down the street?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, that too, but we're fixing all sorts of things around the neighborhood. It'll be fun, promise!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, have you heard when the repair drive is supposed to finish?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I think it wraps up around 2 PM, but I'm not totally sure—I just know I'm bringing my toaster at 10.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to know, I'll try to swing by later then. Thanks, Vik.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, I'll start jotting down names and tools needed. Anyone have a particular item they're missing?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I could use a new set of screwdrivers, if anyone has an extra.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'll mark you down for screwdrivers, Rey. Gus mentioned he has a full set we can borrow from.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Faye, you wanted to talk about the repair drive? Let's hear the details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes! I was thinking we could set up a drop-off spot right after the 3 PM school pickup on Saturday. That way parents can swing by easily.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds convenient. Do we have a specific location in mind near the school?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there's a repair drive happening. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, it's a community thing where people bring broken stuff and fix it together. Sounds neat, but I'm swamped. Got a date?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I'd love to bring my broken lamp and toaster. When's it happening?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane, have you heard about the repair drive we're planning? I think it'd be great if you could join!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, what did I miss?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane! We're putting together a community repair drive—everyone's fixing up broken items together. You're just in time to hear about it!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh man, is it really 10 already? I totally spaced on the time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, 10 already? I hope the repair drive is still on — I was planning to bring that old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think it's still on. I just need to find my hammer... wait, did Gus grab me one?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think we'll need a multimeter, some wrenches, and maybe a soldering kit. I can check the tool library for what they have.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good idea. Let's also grab extension cords and a work light.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great thinking, Leo. I'll swing by the tool library tomorrow to see if they have those, and we can meet at the library's back lot on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I appreciate the offer, but I'm dealing with some things at home. Maybe another time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No problem, Uli. I hope everything's okay at home. Just let me know if you ever need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I'll keep that in mind. It's nothing too serious, just need to sort a few things out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, it's definitely at the community center. I can pick you up if you need help carrying your stuff.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So it's still on? I thought it was supposed to be done by today.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh no, it's this weekend, not today! The flyer said Saturday from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I think I signed up for that, but I can't quite remember when it is... Do you know, Cleo?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's this Saturday, Oren! Most folks are planning to come around 10.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday at 10? Perfect, I'll put it in my phone right now... wait, I think I already did that. Thanks, Cleo!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, I heard about the repair drive. Need any tools or a hand with something?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus! I think we could use an extra hand setting up after the 3 PM school pickup. I'm bringing my tools, but more help is always welcome.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can stick around after 3. Just point me where to go.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
